title: Hot Drinks - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue, at home (e.g., revenue generated in supermarkets and convenience stores) in the Hot Drinks market amounts to US$278.21bn in 2026.
Revenue, out-of-home (e.g., revenue generated in restaurants and bars) amounts to US$582.98bn in 2026.
Revenue, combined amounts to US$861.19bn in 2026.
The revenue, at home is expected to grow annually by 5.17% (CAGR 2026-2031).
In global comparison, most revenue, at home is generated China (US$55bn in 2026).
In relation to total population figures, the average revenue per capita, at home of US$35.20 are generated in 2026.
In the Hot Drinks market, volume, at home is expected to amount to 15.20bn kg by 2026.
Volume, out-of-home is expected to amount to 1.69bn kg in 2026.
Volume, combined is expected to amount to 16.88bn kg in 2026.
The Hot Drinks market is expected to show a volume growth, at home of 1.1% in 2027.
The average volume per person, at home in the Hot Drinks market is expected to amount to 1.92kg in 2026.
